title: Request that the Department Public Utilities make an assessment in accordance with the provisions M.G.L. c. 25, §§ 17 and 18 and c. 111, § 5K, against Boston Edison Edison Company and New England Power Service Company to cover costs incurred by the Department of Public Health for monitoring, surveying and inspecting the Pilgrim and Yankee Rowe nuclear power plants during fiscal years 1991 and 1992.
